decisions.reason: It survived the early market test, fits closely with the firm's core cheese business, and after several years the remaining uncertainty is limited while the cost of keeping it is likely low.

As a somewhat more niche extension its drop risk is higher, but it passed the initial screening and still uses established capabilities, so the option is still worth keeping unless sales clearly disappoint.
This mild soft cheese appears to round out the range well, matches the firm's established competencies, and is therefore the most likely of the three to justify continued shelf space.
